verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AnythingLLM has a public official GitHub repository (Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm) whose source files, such as server/swagger/openapi.json, and releases are readable. Nothing in the pack names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license (e.g., MIT) stated in docs or the repo, and independent confirmation that the full codebase, not just parts, is published.
